title: The Rural English Villages Around RAF Fairford at the Center of a Possible Terrorist Plot
summary_full: The quiet rural area around R.A.F. Fairford, where U.S. bombers fly to Iran, was thrust into the spotlight after the authorities said they were investigating a possible terrorist plot targeting the base.
